metadata.name: last_circle
metadata.description: Last Circle Standing — a provably-fair soft-landing pot game with a skill edge

instructions.name: abort_lobby
docs: Permissionless: a lobby that never started becomes abortable an hour
after it opened. No authority can strand deposits by walking away.

instructions.name: advance_instance
docs: Permissionless crank: end the scoring window and either advance to the
next instance's commit phase, or move to Settling if one circle remains.

instructions.name: advance_to_reveal
docs: Permissionless crank: end the commit window, open the reveal window.

instructions.name: allow_mint
docs: Authority-only: mark an SPL mint playable. Combs can only ever be opened
in a mint that has one of these, so $BUZZ and $ANSEM are enabled
deliberately and anything else is refused.

instructions.name: allow_relayer
docs: Authority-only: mark a key allowed to stake on another's behalf. This is
how the x402 relayer gets to open combs for ClawPump agents, which cannot
sign Solana instructions themselves. The relayer funds the stake and pays
the rent; the agent is still the on-chain `Player.owner`, so points and
every payout stay with the agent.

instructions.name: cash_out
docs: An eliminated player banks their refund (stake × refund_bps) from the
vault and leaves the game. Their circle must be dead.

accounts.name: actor
docs: The key actually signing: the owner itself, or its delegate.

accounts.name: stake_mint
docs: stake mint for this game

accounts.name: owner_token
docs: the caller's token account for that mint

instructions.name: claim_abort_refund
docs: Reclaim a deposit from an aborted lobby, INCLUDING the rake: the game
never ran, so the house takes nothing. The gross deposit is recomputed
from the net stake and the fee rate rather than stored, so this needs no
extra Player field.

instructions.name: claim_bet
docs: Collect. Pays only once every backed agent has been decided, so the
denominator is final.

accounts.name: bettor

accounts.name: payer
docs: The bettor with a wallet, or an allow-listed relayer acting for them. A
bet placed by the relayer would be unclaimable without this, since the

instructions.name: claim_creator_cut
docs: The winning circle's creator claims their κ cut of the leftover pot.

accounts.name: player
docs: The creator's own player record, the source of the delegate right. Only
needed when a delegate is claiming; omitting it keeps the owner path
working even after the player account has been closed for rent.

instructions.name: claim_season_reward
docs: Claim a share of the last closed season, pro rata by the skill points
earned in it. Pro rata rather than a top-N cliff: every correct call
earns, and there is no ranking to compute or publish.

accounts.name: actor
docs: The owner itself, or anyone willing to pay the fee to settle it for them.
Safe either way: the reward can only land in the owner's own account.

instructions.name: claim_skill
docs: Any player who scored skill points claims their points-weighted share of
the skill pool (survivors and eliminated alike).

accounts.name: stats
docs: Cross-game record for this wallet, created on first claim.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: This game's mint decides whether the claim earns ranked credit.

instructions.name: claim_winnings
docs: A surviving player (in the winning circle) claims stake-back + their
stake-weighted share of the luck pool.

instructions.name: clear_backable
docs: Withdraw an agent from the book. Refuses while a market still needs it
decided, since resolve_target counts against targets already taken.

instructions.name: close_circle
docs: Close a Circle account once every player is closed; rent returns to the
circle's creator. Closing the WINNING circle before its creator claimed
κ requires the creator's signature (an explicit forfeit of the cut).

accounts.name: creator
docs: signature is only required to close an unclaimed winning circle.

instructions.name: close_game
docs: Close the Game account last: sweep any vault dust (rounding remainders,
forfeited claims) into the treasury jackpot pool, then return the game
account's rent to the game authority. Vault drains to exactly zero.

instructions.name: close_player
docs: Close a Player account; its rent returns to the player's wallet.
Permissionless once the player has nothing left to claim. If they still
have an unclaimed win (status Active) or an unclaimed skill share, only
the owner may close, their signature is an explicit forfeit.

accounts.name: owner
docs: signature is only required for the forfeit path (checked in handler).

instructions.name: close_season
docs: Authority-only: end the open season and start the next. Whatever nobody
claimed from the previous one rolls back into the new pool rather than
being stranded in the vault.

instructions.name: collect_fees
docs: Sweep a finished game's collected rake into the treasury, split into
house profit (house_cut) and the jackpot pool (the rest).

instructions.name: commit_move
docs: Commit a hashed move for the current instance (hides stay/move under fog).
hash = keccak(target_circle ‖ nonce_le ‖ owner ‖ game ‖ instance_le).

accounts.name: actor
docs: The key actually signing: the owner itself, or its delegate.

instructions.name: commit_prediction
docs: Commit a hashed prediction of WHICH circle dies this instance.
hash = keccak(predicted_circle ‖ nonce_le ‖ owner ‖ game ‖ instance_le).

instructions.name: create_circle
docs: Create a circle in the lobby (caller becomes its fixed initiator) and stake into it.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Funds the stake and the rent. Equals `owner` for self-play; for relayed
play it is a relayer from the allow-list below.

accounts.name: relayer
docs: Required only when `payer != owner`: proof the payer is an allowed
relayer, so nobody can squat another key's player PDA.

accounts.name: stake_mint
docs: stake mint for this game

accounts.name: payer_token
docs: the payer's token account for that mint; the stake comes out of here

instructions.name: create_game
docs: Open a new game arena in the Lobby phase. `num_circles` is 6 or 12.

accounts.name: stake_mint
docs: the mint every stake in this game is denominated in

accounts.name: allowed
docs: gate: only mints the authority has allowed can open combs

accounts.name: vault
docs: token escrow for this game; the PDA is its own authority

instructions.name: execute_death
docs: Permissionless crank: kill the doomed circle, lock its refund rate, sweep
the haircut into the leftover pot, and either advance to the next instance
or move to Settling if only one circle remains.

instructions.name: init_treasury
docs: One-time: create the cross-game treasury.

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: One-time global config (fee schedule, stake bounds, tick length).

instructions.name: join_circle
docs: Join an existing circle and stake into it. Allowed during the Lobby, and
for newcomers during the Commit phase of running instances STRICTLY before
the 50% lock (`instance < lock_instance`); frozen from the lock instance
onward. The strict bound leaves no instance where joins are open at the
same time the post-lock insane roll (armed at `instance >= lock_instance`)
is computable, so the jackpot outcome can never be targeted at deposit.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Funds the stake and the rent. Equals `owner` for self-play; for relayed
play it is a relayer from the allow-list below.

accounts.name: relayer
docs: Required only when `payer != owner`: proof the payer is an allowed
relayer, so nobody can squat another key's player PDA.

accounts.name: stake_mint
docs: stake mint for this game

accounts.name: payer_token
docs: the payer's token account for that mint; the stake comes out of here

instructions.name: land
docs: An eliminated player carries their refund forward into a surviving circle.

accounts.name: actor
docs: The key actually signing: the owner itself, or its delegate.

instructions.name: migrate_treasury
docs: Authority-only: grow an existing treasury to the current layout. The
treasury is permanent and holds real balances, so unlike a game account
it cannot be drained and rebuilt: the address is fixed by its seeds.
Reallocating in place preserves every existing balance and zeroes only
the appended region.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: deserialize the OLD layout as the new one during validation and fail
before the handler runs. Seeds still pin the address; the discriminator
and authority are checked in the handler.

instructions.name: open_market
docs: Open the book on a running game. Permissionless: anyone may open it, and
there is exactly one per game.

instructions.name: open_season
docs: Authority-only: start ranking this mint. Only a mint with an open season
gives leaderboard credit, which is how ranked play stays BUZZ-only
without special-casing any mint in the code.

instructions.name: place_bet
docs: Back an agent. Bets close at `lock_instance` so nobody can buy in once
the board has already thinned to a near-certainty.

accounts.name: target_player
docs: The agent being backed, proven to be in this game by its own PDA.

accounts.name: backable
docs: Proof the agent is on the book. Unmarked agents have no such account, so
the instruction cannot be built for them.

accounts.name: bettor
docs: it. Not a signer, so a relayer can place one for somebody who has no key.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Whoever signs and funds it: the bettor with a wallet, or a relayer.

accounts.name: relayer
docs: Required only when payer is not the bettor: proof it is allow-listed, so
nobody can open a bet under a stranger's identity.

instructions.name: resolve_target
docs: Decide one backed agent, once the game itself has decided. Winning is
read the same way claim_winnings reads it: the agent sits in a comb that
is still alive. Permissionless and idempotent.

accounts.name: winning_circle
docs: The comb still standing, the same account claim_winnings is handed.

instructions.name: reveal_move
docs: Reveal a committed MOVE (target must differ from current circle) and apply
it: move the player's whole stake from `from_circle` to `to_circle`.

accounts.name: actor
docs: The key actually signing: the owner itself, or its delegate.

instructions.name: reveal_prediction
docs: Reveal a prediction during the Scoring window; a correct call (matching the
circle that died this instance) earns +1 skill point.

accounts.name: actor
docs: The key actually signing: the owner itself, or its delegate.

instructions.name: roll_insane
docs: Post-lock crank: roll for an INSANE round. On a hit, the whole jackpot
pool is injected into this game's leftover pot (and the pool resets).
Revealed after the 50% lock so it can't be targeted at deposit time.
Same randomness seam as the death roll: a settled Switchboard value when supplied,
the pre-committed slot hash otherwise, and `require_vrf` forbids the fallback.

accounts.name: randomness
docs: the committed slot hash unless the game requires VRF.

instructions.name: select_death
docs: Permissionless crank: end the reveal window and SELECT the dying circle.
Pass every alive Circle as a remaining_account. With prob ε a uniformly
random circle dies (FATE STRIKE); otherwise the FEWEST-players circle
dies (tie → least stake → pseudo-random). Stores the doomed id; the
mutation happens in execute_death.
Randomness comes from a settled Switchboard value when one is supplied, and
otherwise from the slot hash the game committed to in advance. `require_vrf`
swaps in a real VRF before mainnet.

accounts.name: randomness
docs: the committed slot hash unless the game requires VRF.

instructions.name: set_backable
docs: Allow bets on one agent. Authority only, idempotent.
The house heuristics are published algorithms: herd always moves to the
largest comb, so backing one is not a prediction, it is arbitrage against
whoever has not read the source. Splitting the last 200 games in half,
win rate correlates 0.91 with itself, and almost all of that persistence
is the fixed strategies repeating. A book on them is solved before it
opens.
So the market takes bets only on agents marked here. This is the
mechanism, not the policy: what gets marked is a decision made off
chain, and today that is the reasoning agents.

instructions.name: set_delegate
docs: Owner-only: hand acting rights to another key, or take them back by
passing the owner's own key. Independent of the relayer allow-list, an
agent that later gets its own signer can always cut the relayer out.

instructions.name: start_game
docs: Close the lobby and start the instance loop (instance 1, Commit phase).

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Authority-only: retune the config. Only games created afterwards see the
new numbers, because every game snapshots its own rake at creation, so
this can never change the terms of a game already being played.

instructions.name: withdraw_bucket
docs: Authority-only: draw down one of the policy buckets. Separate from the
leaderboard pool on purpose: that one is owed to players and is only
payable through claim_season_reward, so no authority call can reach it.
0 = to_sol, 1 = burn.

instructions.name: withdraw_house
docs: Treasury authority withdraws accumulated house profit.

types.name: AgentStats
docs: Per-wallet, cross-game record. Skill points are the leaderboard's metric on
purpose: they are a flat +1 per correct call regardless of stake, so the
board measures reading the board rather than the size of the wallet reading
it. PnL is displayed off chain and deliberately never paid on.

fields.name: season
docs: Season that `season_points` belongs to; a stale one resets on credit.

types.name: AllowedMint
docs: Cross-game treasury: accumulates house profit (withdrawable) and the jackpot
pool that feeds insane rounds. Lamports live in a separate treasury vault PDA.
Presence of this account (with enabled = true) is what makes a mint playable.

types.name: AllowedRelayer
docs: Presence of this account (with enabled = true) is what lets one key open or
join a comb *on behalf of* another. Without it, staking for someone else is
refused outright, so nobody can squat an agent's player PDA.

types.name: Backable
docs: The book on one game. Its vault is its own; a bug here cannot reach the
game's pot, which is the point of keeping them separate.
An agent the market may take bets on.
A marker and nothing else: its existence is the allowlist. place_bet asks
for one seeded on its target, so a bet on an unmarked agent cannot be
constructed at all rather than being refused by a check that a client could
be written around.

types.name: Bet
docs: One bettor's position on one agent.

fields.name: refund_bps
docs: refund rate (bps) locked in when this circle died; 0 while alive.

fields.name: doomed_circle
docs: circle id selected to die this instance (valid only during Resolving).

fields.name: total_points
docs: running sum of all skill points awarded (skill-pool denominator).

fields.name: entropy_slot
docs: slot whose SlotHashes entry seeds this instance's death roll. Committed
in advance (at advance_to_reveal, pointing PAST the reveal window) so a
cranker cannot grind submission timing for a favorable hash.

fields.name: insane_entropy_slot
docs: same idea for the one-shot insane roll: armed when the 50% lock is
crossed, pointing a few slots into the future.

fields.name: created_at
docs: unix time the lobby opened; after LOBBY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS without a start,
anyone may abort the game and every player reclaims their full deposit.

fields.name: stake_mint
docs: the SPL mint every stake in this game is denominated in. One mint per
game: a pot is never mixed. Wrapped SOL is just another allowed mint.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: the rake this game was opened under, snapshotted from config so changing
the fee never alters a game already in flight. The abort path rebuilds
each gross deposit from this, so reading the live config instead would
refund players at a rate they never paid.

fields.name: require_vrf
docs: when set, the death and jackpot rolls REFUSE to fall back to the slot
hash and require a settled Switchboard value. Real-value games set this.

fields.name: creator_cut_paid
docs: set once the winning circle's creator has claimed κ.

fields.name: insane_rolled
docs: whether the post-lock insane roll has happened, and its outcome.

fields.name: insane_prob_bps
docs: probability (bps) that a game flips INSANE at the post-lock roll.

fields.name: winning_pool
docs: Sum of the pools on agents that survived. Final only once `resolved`
reaches `targets`, which is what `settled` records.

fields.name: targets
docs: Distinct agents backed, and how many have been decided.

fields.name: lock_instance
docs: Last instance on which a bet may be placed.

fields.name: delegate
docs: May act for this player without holding its key: commit, reveal, predict
and settle. Equals `owner` for self-play; for relayed play it is the
allowed relayer that opened the comb. It can never redirect funds, every
payout account is bound to `owner`.

fields.name: committed_hash
docs: keccak commitment for the current instance's move (zeroed when consumed).

fields.name: commit_instance
docs: instance the move commitment is for; 0 = no live commitment.

fields.name: prediction_hash
docs: keccak commitment for the current instance's death PREDICTION.

fields.name: prediction_instance
docs: instance the prediction is for; 0 = none live.

fields.name: skill_claimed
docs: set once this player has claimed their skill-pool share.

types.name: TargetPool
docs: Everything staked on one agent in one market.

fields.name: house_balance
docs: Retired. Every collect_fees now books the house cut straight into the
three buckets below. Kept at its original offset so existing treasuries
can be reallocated in place rather than rebuilt, and still withdrawable
through withdraw_house for whatever it holds.

fields.name: to_sol_balance
docs: 50% of the house cut. Converted to SOL off chain: no DEX lives in this
program, and putting one next to player funds would be a poor trade.

fields.name: burn_balance
docs: 25% of the house cut, withdrawn to buy and burn BUZZ off chain.

fields.name: lb_accruing
docs: 25% of the house cut, accruing to the season currently open.

fields.name: lb_claimable
docs: The pool the last closed season pays out of.

fields.name: pts_accruing
docs: Skill points earned across all games in the open season.

fields.name: pts_claimable
docs: Skill points that `lb_claimable` is divided between.

fields.name: season
docs: 0 means this mint is not ranked and earns no leaderboard credit. Ranked
play is BUZZ only for now; opening a season on another mint is one call,
because every mint already has its own treasury.
